sources.title: Copernicus DEM - Global and European Digital Elevation Model
sources.access_depth: Full bounded official source document acquired and relevant sections inspected
sources.locator: Dataset specifications, Horizontal resolution and vertical accuracy, CRS, Releases and user obligations
sources.observation: This edited DSM includes buildings/vegetation and principally 2011–2015 TanDEM-X data plus infills. GLO-30 has 1 arcsec latitude sampling, WGS 84-G 1150 horizontal CRS, EGM 2008 vertical heights in metres. Published specifications give <4 m absolute vertical LE90, <2 m relative error on slopes≤20%, <4 m above 20% and <6 m horizontal CE90. Current CDSE releases include 2024_1.

sources.access_depth: Full bounded official source document acquired and relevant sections inspected
sources.locator: 29 November 2022; §1.2.5.3, printedp.20; product structure and quality layers
sources.observation: The HEM represents random height uncertainty derived from interferometric coherence and geometry. It excludes systematic offsets and phase-unwrapping errors; edited cells use a special mask value. Original packages include HEM/edit/fill/water layers. A mirror exposing only elevation cannot supply those local error fields.
